title: Cobalt — GraphQL from TypeScript, without writing GraphQL
excerpt: Cobalt infers a GraphQL schema from your TypeScript resolvers and generates a typed SDK. No schema files, no glue code. Open source, powered by Samarium.
content_html:
The Power of GraphQL, without ``GraphQL``.
The last framework that actually makes sense, in the age of AI.

No dependencies. GraphQL selections are optional.
